attchmntText: JBF Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: JBF Industries Limited, under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process, filed un-audited financial results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. The results were approved by Resolution Professional Mukesh Verma on 12 November 2026. The company reported a net loss of Rs. 74 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 118 lakhs for the half-year. Earnings per share stood at negative Rs. 0.09 for the quarter. Independent auditor S.C. Ajmera & Co. issued a qualified opinion. The qualification cites non-provision of interest aggregating Rs. 2,47,379 lakhs on term loans and cash credit limits. The auditor also noted uncertainty regarding a Rs. 12,848 lakhs claim by an operational creditor of subsidiary JBF RAK LLC. An emphasis of matter highlights the company's cessation as a going concern. Additional matters include a subjudice recovery proceeding by Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd for Rs. 32.94 Crores, invocation of corporate guarantees, and failure to appoint key managerial personnel including the CEO, CFO, and Company Secretary. Consolidated financial statements were not prepared.
